changeSet.author: walid
changeSet.comment: Snapshot of the values reached by each version. The audit trail records who did what and when; this table records what the document looked like once that action succeeded, so a reader can compare versions without replaying the history.
changeSet.sql: -- Documents written before this changeset keep the state their current version reached; -- earlier versions cannot be reconstructed and stay without stored values. INSERT INTO document_versions (id, document_id, business_version, title, status) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), document.id, document.business_version, document.title, document.status FROM documents document; INSERT INTO document_version_sections (id, version_id, section_position, title, content) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), version.id, section.section_position, section.title, section.content FROM document_sections section JOIN document_versions version ON version.document_id = section.document_id AND version.business_version = (SELECT current_document.business_version FROM documents current_document WHERE current_document.id = section.document_id);
